name: When Winter Ends
source:
Two strangers:

A mysterious little girl, and a lone traveler. 

The two met unexpectedly, seeking shelter from the raging storm outside. Play as each of them to figure out their past and their wishes for the future.

[From [url=https://summerorigins.itch.io/when-winter-ends]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个陌生人。
一个神秘的小女孩，一位独行的旅人。
为了躲避外头肆虐的风暴，两人意外相遇。分别扮演他们，了解各自的过去，以及他们对未来的期盼。

[译自[url=https://summerorigins.itch.io/when-winter-ends]itch.io[/url]]
